verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is a law firm. User-configurable, autonomously running background automations are a software-platform capability outside a legal-services firm's category. Its client tools do not flip the axis: the SCC and Term Sheet generators are interactive, step-by-step questionnaires, the Legora assistant streamlines workflows, and 'Evaluate' is a firm-run review tool. None is an automation a user sets up to run on its own in the background.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
